description: Free. Create an empty collection to add sources to later with `add_sources`. Maps to POST /v1/collections. Returns the collection and its `collection_token` (`ct_…`, shown once: store it; absent on an idempotent replay). API key required (the key's `write` scope). Prices are the service defaults; `quote` returns the exact price.
name: create_collection
title: Create an empty collection
